faqs.question: Can I use my own billing system?
faqs.answer: Yes. KubeDB provides comprehensive metering APIs that can be integrated into any existing billing or ERP system.

faqs.question: Does it support white-labeled documentation?
faqs.answer: Yes. We provide a customizable documentation template that you can host on your own domain with your branding.
